column1: # Kegare, a demon from another age who has taken Mia's visage.

column3: At last. I have watched\nyou protect Mia. Now I\nunderstand her trust.{end_wait}
You look exactly like Mia.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

I am Kegare, a demon
from an age long past. I
studied her every move.{page_break}Now I will take her place.
Her life and name will be
mine.{end_wait}
Mia is not yours to replace.\nYou'll have to get through\nus first.{end_wait}
You may wear my face,\nbut you do not know my\nlife. You cannot claim me.{end_wait}
Let them decide who is\nreal. When I am finished,\nthey will choose me.{end_wait}
They know me by my choices,\nnot the shape of my face.\nYou will never become me.{end_wait}
